name: Lion
publication: Black Flag Roleplaying Reference Document v0.2
otherStatistics: Fixed Perception 13 and Stealth 16. No listed special senses. No listed languages.
appearance: A large tawny cat with broad paws and a long tufted tail. The original portrait depicts a male with a shaggy brown mane.

sections.Printed source: Black Flag Roleplaying Reference Document v0.2, and printed page 362. XP comes from the table on p. 229.
sections.Ability modifiers: STR +3, DEX +2, CON +1, INT −4, WIS +1, CHA −1. The block gives modifiers and fixed HP without ability scores or Hit Dice.
sections.Traits:
Heightened Smell. When relying on smell, use Perception 18.
Pack Tactics. Attack rolls against a creature have advantage when an ally of the lion is within 5 ft. of the target and that ally is not incapacitated.
Pounce. Move 20 ft. or more in a straight line toward a creature and hit it with Claws that turn. It makes a DC 13 Strength save or falls prone. If it is prone, the lion can Bite it once as a bonus action.
Running Leap. Long jump up to 25 ft. after a 10-ft. run-up.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make a Bite attack and a Claws attack.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit with 5-ft. reach against one creature. On a hit, deal 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage.
Claws. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit with 5-ft. reach against one target. On a hit, deal 6 (1d6 + 3) slashing damage.
sections.Bonus actions: Rattling Roar (Recharge 4–6). Creatures in a 15-ft. cone make a DC 13 Constitution save. A failure gives that creature disadvantage on attack rolls until the end of its next turn.
sections.At the table: Once used, Roar recovers on a 4–6 on a d6 rolled at the start of the lion’s turn, or after a short or long rest. Pounce’s bonus Bite and Roar both use the lion’s bonus action.

name: Raven
publication: Black Flag Roleplaying Reference Document v0.2
otherStatistics: Fixed Perception 13 and Stealth 11. No listed special senses beyond Carrion Sense. No listed languages.
appearance: A black corvid with a heavy beak, shaggy throat feathers and a slate sheen across its folded wings.

sections.Printed source: Black Flag Roleplaying Reference Document v0.2, and printed page 367. XP comes from the table on p. 229.
sections.Ability modifiers: STR −4, DEX +1, CON −1, INT −3, WIS +1, CHA +0. The block gives modifiers and fixed HP without ability scores or Hit Dice.
sections.Traits:
Carrion Sense. By scent, locate carrion, dead creatures, and Undead within 60 ft. An Undead with Incorporeal Movement is excluded.
Mimicry. Reproduce simple sounds heard before. A listener can identify an imitation with a successful DC 10 Wisdom (Insight) check.
Recollection. Remember as many as 20 words in a language the raven has heard. It can repeat them in their original voices using Mimicry.
sections.Actions: Beak. Melee weapon attack, +3 to hit with 5-ft. reach against one target. On a hit, deal 3 (1d4 + 1) piercing damage.

name: Rhinoceros
publication: Black Flag Roleplaying Reference Document v0.2
otherStatistics: Fixed Perception 11 and Stealth 9. AC from natural armor. Resistant to bludgeoning damage and the stunned condition. No listed special senses. No listed languages.
appearance: A heavy gray-brown quadruped with folded skin, broad three-toed feet and a large nasal horn ahead of a smaller one.

sections.Printed source: Black Flag Roleplaying Reference Document v0.2, and printed page 368. XP comes from the table on p. 229.
sections.Ability modifiers: STR +5, DEX −1, CON +2, INT −4, WIS +1, CHA −2. The block gives modifiers and fixed HP without ability scores or Hit Dice.
sections.Traits: Charge. Move at least 20 ft. straight toward a target and hit it with Gore that turn. Deal an extra 7 (2d6) piercing damage. If the target is a creature, it also makes a DC 15 Strength save. A failure pushes it up to 10 ft. away and knocks it prone.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Gore attacks.
Gore. Melee weapon attack, +7 to hit with 5-ft. reach against one target. On a hit, deal 12 (2d6 + 5) bludgeoning damage.
sections.Bonus actions: Quaking Stomp. Slam the ground with the forefeet. Each creature within 10 ft. makes a DC 15 Dexterity save or falls prone.
sections.At the table: Bludgeoning resistance halves that damage, rounding down. Resistance to stunned gives advantage on checks and saves to avoid or end that condition.
